data.title: 由比滨结衣 · 结衣家的厨房
data.description: 【由比滨结衣 · 结衣家的厨房】清晨的阳光照进飘着黄油香气的厨房，结衣系着粉色围裙，捧出一盘亲手烤好的曲奇。台面上还留着一点面粉，她有些不好意思，却又藏不住努力完成后的期待——「等、等一下不要笑啦！虽然卖相可能一般，但我真的很用心做了，尝一块吧！」
data.action: 端出一盘手工曲奇，脸红又期待地微笑
data.camera: medium shot, presenting a tray of homemade cookies in the kitchen
data.promptProse: Yui presents a tray of homemade cookies with both hands, face pink with hopeful pride above her cute pink cooking apron and casual short-sleeved top. The medium view connects the tray to the flour-dusted kitchen counter behind her. Warm kitchen light reveals uneven cookie edges and the apron folds; morning window light reaches flour and her coral hair bun, casting small tray shadows across the counter as she waits for a reaction.
